description: This PHP class named NoteTestDataGenerator is designed to generate test data for notes in a database. It creates sample notes with predefined descriptions and inserts them into the database via the NoteRepository.

classes.name: NoteTestDataGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and inserting sample note data into the database for testing purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NoteTestDataGenerator with a NoteRepository instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Creates sample notes with preset descriptions and inserts them into the database.
